jana (Partnerships): Quick update 1: Novara Systems just listed a bundled image on the DigitalOcean Marketplace that includes our Redwood Private agent for their edge appliance. They pinged yesterday and want a short partner blurb we can use in the listing :tada:

sam (Sales): Nice! Do we have an initial ARR signal or pilot size?

jana (Partnerships): It's an initial 3-month pilot with 25 edge nodes, expected to scale to +100 nodes if throughput looks good. Financial terms are pilot NRE + consumption.

omar (Solutions): They need a sample onboarding doc for the appliance image and a small FAQ about firewall/NAT rules. Also ask about cert rotation for long-lived devices.

li (Engineering): For device certs we recommend our device-auth flow with short-lived certs + auto-rotation. Example curl to enroll:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/enroll \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ENROLL_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"device_id":"node-123","meta":{"region":"eu-west-1"}}'
```
The image will call our private agent over mTLS; need to ensure customers expose port 8443.

novara-ci-bot: CI build 2026-01-18T09:14:02Z - marketplace-image: PASS (sha: d4f8a7c)

nina (Marketing): Oooo let's get a short partner quote and a diagram. Recommend holding any public co-announcement until pilot kickoff. Can someone capture a 1-2 sentence quote during onboarding?

jana (Partnerships): I'll request a quote in the kickoff and share the marketplace blurb. Draft blurb below, feedback welcome:
"Novara Systems and Redwood Inference enable low-latency inference at the edge with a turnkey appliance image that includes Redwoods Private agent for secure, managed LLM serving."

omar (Solutions): Tiny wording nit: "Redwoods" should read "Redwood's" (straight apostrophe). Also add "SSO & device cert rotation supported" if space allows.

jana (Partnerships): Updated blurb:
"Novara Systems and Redwood Inference deliver low-latency edge inference with a turnkey appliance image that bundles Redwood's Private agent for secure, managed LLM serving. Supports SSO and device cert rotation for enterprise deployments."

sam (Sales): I've flagged this in CRM as "Marketplace Partner 1 Pilot" and created an opportunity for ARR expansion if nodes >50. Tagging AE for renewal playbook.

li (Engineering): Quick tech note: Novara's image mounts /etc/redwood/conf and expects `agent.conf` with `heartbeat_interval` set to 30s. We'll add a sample systemd unit to our docs.

novara-ci-bot: marketplace test harness: image boot smoke OK, agent heartbeats observed from 25 nodes at 2026-01-18T09:22:10Z

nina (Marketing): I'll prep a one-pager and an internal partner FAQ. We'll wait for the first week of pilot metrics before any external post.

jana (Partnerships): Next steps: (1) li: sample systemd + agent.conf snippet by tomorrow EOD, (2) omar: onboarding checklist + firewall doc, (3) nina: partner FAQ draft. Will open private channel `#novara-integration` and invite vendor point of contact. Great work team! :rocket:
